subject: Quick thought on the Culinary Dropout Austin menu layout
body: Hi Culinary Dropout team, I recently visited your Austin location online and stopped by to check out your scratch-made dishes and weekend live music setup. I noticed that relying on external PDF downloads for your antipasti, starters, and craft cocktails can slow things down on mobile devices and limits how search engines index your menu items. I spent a bit of time putting together a modern, live prototype that translates your menu into fast, HTML-rendered tabs with quick anchor navigation, plus an optimized signup for your e-bites club. Feel free to check out the live preview here: https://nayom-biz-0x8644cc72561ee0d5-0xe12eff88147950f-2vufzc85p.vercel.app. If you would like to use this design or have me tweak anything, I would be happy to send over the project files or chat for five minutes. No worries at all if you are happy with your current setup!
key_improvements: Replaced heavy external PDF menu links with fast, HTML-rendered interactive menu tabs
Optimized the e-bites club newsletter signup section for better mobile conversion
